acceptance_criteria.details: findAll, findById, create, update, delete methods

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC2: Typed returns using Drizzle inference

discoveries.context: Need type-safe repository without manual interface definitions
discoveries.lesson: Use typeof table.$inferSelect for repository return types
discoveries.code_pattern:
type ProjectSelect = typeof projects.$inferSelect;
type ProjectInsert = typeof projects.$inferInsert;

discoveries.discovery: .returning() may return undefined in edge cases
discoveries.context: Update with no matching rows returns undefined
discoveries.code_pattern:
const [result] = await db.update(table).returning();
if (!result) throw new Error('Not found');

what_worked: Repository pattern provides clean data access layer
Type inference from schema keeps types in sync

new_patterns.name: DRIZZLE_TYPE_INFERENCE
new_patterns.description: Use Drizzle's $inferSelect/$inferInsert for automatic type derivation
